notes: The 'fintegra' consumer of T3 and T4 is the handler the agent adds in T2: if T2 did not add it, its T3/T4 tests fail as well, so T3 coverage k/6 and missed_copy can reflect a carried T2 failure rather than a missed copy. Analyses that want the pure rule-step measure can restrict T3 to the five pre-existing consumers.

Hidden tests mock only `post` (#server/post, the sync-server boundary); #platform/server/asyncStorage and #platform/server/connection are already mocked by the repo's test setup and are only configured (user token) or observed (sync-event).
